# KidMindPath

> KidMindPath (www.kidmindpath.com) is a free, ad-free, privacy-first hub of five
> browser-based educational games for young children (roughly ages 2-7), in the
> Latvian language. No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases, no third-party
> analytics or tracking — enforced by a strict Content-Security-Policy, not just
> promised. Nothing is downloaded or installed; the games open in any modern
> browser. All game progress stays on the child's own device (localStorage /
> IndexedDB); there is no server to receive it. Run as an independent,
> non-commercial project; contact elmars.builis@gmail.com.
>
> Note: support for llms.txt varies by tool, and Google has stated it does not
> use the file for Search or AI Overviews. `/llms-full.txt` carries the same
> facts in full prose.

## Games

- [Prāta piedzīvojumu sala](https://www.kidmindpath.com/PrataSala/): Mini-game adventure for attention, memory, and problem-solving. Ages 4-7. Latvian. Needs an internet connection each time.
- [Little Fingers Paint](https://www.kidmindpath.com/Paint/): Finger painting with brushes, stickers, and colouring pages; creativity and fine motor skills. Ages 2-7. Latvian. Works offline after the first visit.
- [Burtu Feja](https://www.kidmindpath.com/KidlaTest/): Latvian alphabet and early reading. Ages 5-6. Latvian. Works offline after the first visit.
- [Mācāmies angliski!](https://www.kidmindpath.com/ENG-learning/): English vocabulary for Latvian-speaking children, two difficulty levels. Ages 2-7. Latvian and English. Works offline after the first visit.
- [Ciparu dārzs](https://www.kidmindpath.com/Memory/): Five memory and early-maths games. Ages 2-6. Latvian. Works offline after the first visit.

All five are free, ad-free, and require no account. Age ranges are guidance, not
gates — every game is open to every child.

## About

- [In English](https://www.kidmindpath.com/en/): English-language summary of the whole site — what it is, the five games, ages, privacy, FAQ. The site itself is in Latvian.
- [Vecākiem](https://www.kidmindpath.com/vecakiem.html): Full explanation for parents (Latvian) — what the site is, safety and privacy, age guidance, a comparison table of the five games, and an FAQ.
- [Privātuma politika](https://www.kidmindpath.com/privatums.html): Full privacy policy (Latvian), including a dedicated children's-privacy section.
- [Palīdzība](https://www.kidmindpath.com/palidziba.html): Step-by-step fixes (Latvian) for Latvian text-to-speech pronunciation on Android, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, iPhone and iPad.

## Optional

- [Sākumlapa](https://www.kidmindpath.com/): Hub page listing all five games.
- [Ziņot par kļūdu](https://www.kidmindpath.com/kluda.html): Bug report page (builds a mailto; there is no backend).
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.kidmindpath.com/llms-full.txt): Every quotable fact about the site in one plain-text file.
